title: GPT-5.2 routing addresses blocked responses
summary:
A day of fixes for GPT-5.2 responses, Usage CSV downloads, and a dashboard table that wanted more room than it had.

The `openai-large` route for GPT-5.2 was updated to address content-policy blocks that prevented text responses.

Enter’s auth and dashboard endpoints now expose the Content-Disposition header to browser code, addressing a permission error when downloading Usage CSV files.

The API keys table is more compact, with six single-line column headings and no horizontal scroll container.
